response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical expertise across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, and AI-agent infrastructure) and entrepreneurial experience through his open-source GISCollective platform. While his background aligns well with cloud and AI-adjacent work, his lack of a formal AI/ML degree or direct experience building AI-powered products at scale slightly limits his fit for a Principal Engineer role focused on AI strategy.
strengths: Diverse technical experience spanning 15+ years in software, hardware, and infrastructure engineering, including modern cloud and AI-adjacent tools (e.g., AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq).
Entrepreneurial mindset with a successful open-source project (GISCollective) and founder experience, showcasing leadership and innovation.
Strong full-stack and polyglot development skills (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, etc.) with a focus on testability and user experience.
concerns: No formal advanced degree in AI/ML or direct experience building AI-powered products/platforms at scale, which is a preferred qualification.
Limited evidence of high-level strategic contributions (e.g., advising customers on AI adoption or shaping cloud product roadmaps) in current roles.
Career includes shorter stints (e.g., 1–2 years at some companies), which may raise questions about depth of impact in leadership contexts.
